appealLevels.name: Internal Reconsideration
appealLevels.notes: Request reconsideration within 30 days of decision.

appealLevels.name: Workers' Compensation Appeals Tribunal (WCAT)
appealLevels.notes: Appeal to independent WCAT within 30 days of reconsideration decision.

workplaceInjury.notes: WCB Nova Scotia administers workplace injury benefits. Two-tier appeal: Internal Reconsideration, then WCAT.

humanRights.name: Nova Scotia Human Rights Commission
humanRights.notes: File complaint within 12 months of last discriminatory act.
